description: Settlement date on the Payments Canada holiday calendar, and the accrual fraction under ACT/360, ACT/365F, 30/360, 30E/360 or ACT/ACT-ISDA. Send all seven inputs, including acknowledge no-ruling-v1 and a freshness_tolerance in whole days written P<n>D. It refuses rather than guesses: a missing acknowledgement or tolerance, a tolerance over the ratified ceiling, calendar data older than your tolerance, a trade date outside the calendar's coverage or not a business day, and any missing, unknown or malformed input. Costs $0.01 in USDC on Base per computed answer, under x402; a refusal is not charged. The answer is the JSON envelope of https://foundry.dap.solutions/api/compute-day-count-to-settlement, byte for byte, with the artifact hash that answered. Full rules: https://foundry.dap.solutions/hub.md

accrual_start.description: a real calendar date, the first day of the accrual period, counted

trade_date.description: a business day on the calendar
